name: Falmouth Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at The Lugger Inn. Open Wed and Sat 10am-2pm. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Cornwall Council Allotments
short_description: Cornwall Council allotment sites in Falmouth area
description: Several sites available in Falmouth area. Plots from £40/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage.

name: The Wildlife Trust - Tresillian Centre
short_description: Wildlife trust community garden and education centre
description: Volunteer-run community project with growing spaces and wildlife education. Harvest shared among volunteers and local families in need.
